svg.title: SMAART student dashboard flow
svg.desc: Student journey from first login through profile, T1 baseline, learning, assessments, to Skills Passport
svg.text: Student dashboard — what happens, in order

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the SMAART student first login flow')

svg.text: ⬇ gate: must verify OTP + change password

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Describe the SMAART 12-step student DNA onboarding wizard')
sendPrompt('Explain the SMAART T1 baseline assessment')

svg.text: ⬇ gate: T1 submitted → auto-redirect to dashboard

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What tools are available on the SMAART student dashboard?')
g.text: AI chat, resume builder, Mind Care

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the SMAART 3-day learning framework and 75 skills')

svg.text: ⬇ gate: each phase unlocks next assessment

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain SMAART T2 assessment and C1 certificate')
sendPrompt('Explain SMAART T3 assessment and C2 certificate')
sendPrompt('Explain SMAART T4 assessment and C3 diploma')
sendPrompt('What is the SMAART Skills Passport and how is it generated?')

svg.text: Click any phase to learn more
